item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 06/Aug/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will be generally fine and persistently very hot over southern China in the next few days. With the anticyclone aloft weakening gradually and under the influence of a southwesterly airstream, there will be a few showers over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend to early next week. Besides, the broad area of low pressure will linger over the seas east of Taiwan in the next few days, bringing unsettled weather to the region.
